title: Public audience: cadence family, membership since/until and as-of fan-out
description: Move the cadence-family rule (one list per family per reader), membership since/until with a host-supplied effective time for moves, and as-of fan-out (audienceAsOf) into PublicAudience, the router and the event schema, so every item reaches a reader by exactly one route.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decisions: (1) subscribe refuses any request naming two lists of one family, regardless of what the reader holds, so the answer reveals nothing about the address; update_preferences and import refuse two NEW lists (not held). (2) Moved-off rows keep status subscribed with until, and stay in the byList index, so an as-of fan-out for an earlier instant still finds the reader; plain leaves become unsubscribed with until=now and leave the index. (3) byList is KEYS_ONLY, so subscriber_page does one get per row. (4) Preferences view shows held lists (the choice made: new list on, old off) during a pending move. (5) email send-time receiving/links_for take the item's audienceAsOf so a late-sent as-of summary still reaches a reader who has since moved off.
